# android asks for the INTERNET permission only for a program that reaches the
# network: a request through sngl:http, or a picture a URL names. Robolectric
# grants nothing and checks nothing, so a run cannot say it; the manifest does.

sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --opt=main=true --out=req request.sngl
grep 'android.permission.INTERNET' req/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml

sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --opt=main=true --out=img remote.sngl
grep 'android.permission.INTERNET' img/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml

sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --opt=main=true --out=none offline.sngl
! grep 'android.permission.INTERNET' none/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml

-- request.sngl --
import http "sngl:http"
import . "sngl:ui"

component asker node {
    var status = 0
    button(text="ask", @click {
        match var r = http.get(url="https://example.com/") {
            ok { status = r.status }
            failed { status = -1 }
        }
    })
    text(value="{status}")
}

window {
    asker
}
-- remote.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"

window {
    image {
        remote(url="https://example.com/a.png")
    }
}
-- offline.sngl --
import json "sngl:json"
import . "sngl:ui"

window {
    text(value=json.encode([1, 2]))
}
